senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גבי, גבב)cavity for collecting water, pond, cistern.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:1">Tosef. Mikv. I, 1</cite> <he>המים שבגבא</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 1:1">Mikv. I, 1</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>שבגבו</he>, read <he>שבגֵבַי</he>) the water in the pond.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> (ref. to <he>ישקני</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">ib.</cite>) <he>יטהרני כאדם שהוא מישק שני ג׳ וכ׳</he> may He make me pure, as a man levels the surface of two ponds (by which the unclean one is purified).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94b:17">Snh. 94ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:4">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מי ג׳</he> stagnant waters, opp. <he>נחל שוטף</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:1:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:13">Tosef. Mikv. I, 13</cite> <he>כמין גבאין</he> ed. Zuck. (read <cite ref="K00790"><he>כְּמֵי</he></cite>).
